Privacy Policy

This policy explains how we collect, use and protect personal data of customers who use our services.

Data Retention

Personal data is retained for 24 months after the end of the customer relationship and is then deleted or anonymised.

Your Rights

Under the GDPR you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by writing to privacy@contoso.example. Requests are answered within one month.

Cookies

We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and optional analytics cookies only with your consent.
